name: colors
description: Colors: the 76 Pancakes engine (TypeScript: core, sports/nfl engine/app/view, platform adapters). Engine, app and view code import no framework. npm test needs the WHOLE repo checked out (tests read ../data and ../tools). The only app entry is src/main.ts, a framework-free dev page that plays one game on the baked pools pack (data/packs) and shows its box score; it is not the product UI, which waits on the framework verdict. dev/build/preview run Vite against index.html. Framework: Svelte 5 + Vite 8 (decided; React removed at cutover prep, 20 Nov 2026). svelte, vite and @sveltejs/vite-plugin-svelte are installed for the product UI; nothing in src, test or tools imports them yet. The old esbuild bundler (build/build.mjs) was removed on 2026-11-13.
